$comment: Contract for the shared console UI under src/shared-console. `npm run verify:shared-ui` enforces every hash and the allowlist below.

artifact.$comment: A neutral, sanitized copy of a shared console kit. Origin identity is deliberately not recorded: this project does not retain it, and the copy is not traceable back to a source by design.

license.$comment: The sole copyright holder has authorized this neutral extraction for redistribution under the repository MIT license.

authorization.$comment: The copyright holder explicitly authorized public release and redistribution of this extraction under MIT.

sanitization.$comment: The copy was audited for company, privacy, and confidential content before it entered this repository. No secrets, credentials, endpoints, customer names, or subject data were present; the only external URL is the public Google Fonts CDN. Findings were removed rather than documented: naming them here would reproduce in this repository exactly what the audit existed to remove. verify:shared-ui enforces the result with a hashed denylist.
categories_removed: brand mark component and brand accent colour
product naming in file headers and the design doc
confidential business-domain vocabulary in the stage table
product-domain vocabulary and colour tokens unrelated to this prototype
unused decorative and legacy classes tied to the source product

renamed.detail: The source's brand initials were embedded in the class API across the kit, tokens, preset, and design doc.

verified_absent: API keys, tokens, passwords, bearer credentials
internal hostnames, endpoints, or cloud storage paths

visible_component_allowlist.$comment: Section 6.3 authorizes exactly three new visible components. SessionPage is page composition, not a design primitive. A fourth requires a plan revision.
